why: Check 7 can only inspect a stamped symbol it can RESOLVE; an unresolved ref yields no finding, so losing resolution is indistinguishable from passing. This number is the floor: a drop is an ERROR (rc 7). Raising it is the point -- when the resolver improves, update this file in the same commit and say what changed.
standing_gap: 134 refs unresolved. NOT a defect count -- it mixes refs naming a header that only declares the symbol, refs whose symbol appears solely in comments, and genuine parser gaps. Classifying them is the todo-metadata-layer TODO's Check-7 coverage section (open work).
